title: Marvel's Wolverine: The Big Preview – First hands-on and developer access with the superhero slasher
strapline: Our hands-on impressions and developer access explore how Insomniac is shaping Wolverine into a structured, action-centric adventure built around Logan.

related.title: Marvel's Wolverine was inspired by one of the few video game movie tie-ins that doesn't suck: "We had the same challenges as those devs"

related.author: Jordan Gerblick

related.title: "It's a relentless onslaught": Insomniac community lead calls out social media algorithms for pushing negativity
related.strapline: James Stevenson says the online backlash is not representative of the wider opinion around Wolverine.
related.author: Catherine Lewis

related.title: Marvel's Wolverine will make sure squeamish players never have to see blood and gore: "We don't want to surprise anyone"
related.strapline: Insomniac explains how its accessibility options can turn off blood, gore, and dismemberment.
related.author: Dustin Bailey
